# Get4Domain

> Get4Domain is India's all-in-one online identity and business platform for small and medium businesses (SMBs). "DomainApp" gives a business an industry-specific website plus a complete business workspace (CRM, GST invoicing, appointments/bookings/orders, campaigns, WhatsApp and an AI content studio) from ₹999/month, billed annually. Get4Domain also offers "DomainCampaign" (managed Meta and Google ads and growth) and custom-quoted "Managed Services" (bespoke software and managed marketing). Built by KSM Quantum Technologies, Chennai, India.

## What Get4Domain does
- Gives an SMB a professional, industry-specific website (each industry gets tailored pages, records and workflows — a clinic gets appointments and patients; a restaurant gets menu and orders; real estate gets properties and site visits).
- Provides a full business workspace/dashboard: CRM leads, customers, GST-compliant invoicing, accounts and reports, staff/team access.
- Includes marketing tools: campaigns, WhatsApp business messaging, and an AI Studio for content and images.
- Offers a customer portal so a business's own customers can book, order, and pay.
- Serves 20 industries: clinic/healthcare, salon, gym/fitness, coaching, education, professional services, finance, diagnostics, photography, hotel, events, travel, restaurant, retail, agriculture, automobile, construction, technology, logistics, and real estate.

## Pricing
- DomainApp Workspace: ₹999/month equivalent, billed annually — ₹11,988 + 18% GST (₹14,145.84) per year. Industry website, CRM and TeleCRM, GST invoicing, basic expense management, website auto-bot reply, SEO/GEO/AEO bundle, 3 free SEO keywords, 2 theme changes per year, ₹499 one-time AI Studio credit.
- DomainApp BOS: ₹1,999/month equivalent, billed annually — ₹23,988 + 18% GST (₹28,305.84) per year. Everything in Workspace plus WhatsApp bot reply, task management, full GST and P&L accounting, 6 free SEO keywords, 4 theme changes per year and a ₹1,299 one-time AI Studio credit. HRM and Office management are on the BOS roadmap (coming soon, not yet available).
- DomainCampaign (managed Meta and Google ads, content, analytics, SEO/GEO/AEO and organic distribution): flat monthly management fee by monthly ad budget — up to ₹20,000: ₹2,000; ₹20,001 to ₹1,00,000: ₹5,000; above ₹1,00,000: ₹10,000; plus 18% GST. Enterprise or multi-brand clients: custom quote. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta/Google and is separate.
- Managed Services (custom web and mobile applications, bespoke CRM/ERP/business software, managed paid ads, social media management, content creation, influencer collaboration, commercial ad production): custom-quoted per project; no fixed price list.
- Usage (AI Studio, WhatsApp, SMS, email) is pay-per-use from a prepaid wallet. Full comparison: https://get4domain.com/pricing
- Free demo available; a consultant sets up and customizes the site within 24 hours.

## Who it's for
Indian small and medium businesses that want a professional website and the software to run day-to-day operations, without hiring developers or stitching together multiple tools.
